CONSTRUCTED FIXTURES. Every file here was written by hand on 2026-11-10. None
is a captured vendor answer: no key exists yet, no call to The Odds API was
ever made for them, and vendor data is never committed (RC R1, R6). They
replace nothing real; the first-key probe (scripts/probe_oddsapi.py, design
section 10) checks the shapes against live answers, and these files follow
whatever it finds (design section 14, step 7b).

Shapes: only fields the vendor documents, from its v4 guide (the event-odds
example, UT/docs_v4.txt:1504-1586; the events example, 1409-1453; the
participants example, 1754-1886) and its OpenAPI schema
(UL/api_reference_v4_schema.yml: events 502-624, event odds 625-885,
participants 1039-1116, Outcome 1979-2014). UT and UL are the vendor-page
copies in BucketValueDev/understand/text and understand/live. The
timestamp is the MARKET-level last_update only: the bookmaker-level one is
deprecated and absent on event odds (docs 1053, 1501), so no file carries it
(a test adds one to prove the parser never reads it). No file holds a
key-shaped string: tests build their fake key at run time ("K" * 40).

Players and games are the serve fixture's REAL ones for 2026-03-12
(tests/fixtures/serve: 0022500953 PHI at DET, 7:00 PM ET, and 0022500958 DEN
at SAS, 9:00 PM ET), so later stages can match the names against its roster.
Names are spelled in plain ASCII, as a book may spell them ("Nikola Jokic",
"Jonas Valanciunas"); the roster's own spellings carry the accents. Lines,
prices, timestamps and the 32-character event ids are INVENTED. DFS prices
(PrizePicks, Underdog) are all -137, as on every standard NFL PrizePicks and
Underdog line read on 2026-09-03 (report_feed.md 1.5); the first-key probe
found the same on NBA standard lines on 2026-11-11. The vendor's own titles
are as its pages list them ("Underdog Fantasy"); the site never shows them.

events_constructed.json
  GET /v4/sports/basketball_nba/events on the morning of 2026-03-12. The nine
  games of that date's real slate (tests/fixtures/pipeline/schedule.parquet),
  with their real tips in UTC: four of them (DAL at MEM 00:00Z, DEN at SAS,
  BOS at OKC, CHI at LAL) start on the NEXT UTC day and still belong to
  2026-03-12 ET. Plus one INVENTED event, GSW at LAC at 2026-03-14T02:30:00Z
  (2026-03-13 ET), which the vendor's listing of later games would include and
  the parser must drop; it also carries the vendor-style "Los Angeles
  Clippers". The list is deliberately not in tip order (whether the vendor
  sorts it is UNVERIFIED, RF part 4 fact 12).

event_odds_phi_det_constructed.json
  GET .../events/{id}/odds for PHI at DET, as answered for
  bookmakers=draftkings,fanduel,betmgm,prizepicks,underdog and
  markets=player_points,player_rebounds,player_assists,player_fantasy_points.
  64 outcomes. What each part encodes:
    draftkings  three markets, every line an Over/Under pair.
    fanduel     Cade Cunningham at two points, the off-centre 24.5 pair
                (-142/+112) listed BEFORE the main 25.5 pair (-114/-106): the
                main line is the pair whose implied probabilities are closest,
                not the first one. Daniss Jenkins Over only (a "more" line).
    betmgm      Jalen Duren Under only (a "less" line). VJ Edgecombe's Over has
                NO point: that outcome is skipped and counted, never read as
                0, and his Under at 16.5 stands alone.
    prizepicks  the board.txt lines where the serve fixture's paste has them
                (Cunningham 25.5 points and 8.5 assists, Duren 10.5 rebounds,
                Jenkins 7.5, Edgecombe 17.5, Maxey 24.5), plus a fantasy line,
                which the feed keeps for PrizePicks.
    underdog    three points lines and a fantasy line, which the feed drops
                (Underdog's fantasy formula is UNVERIFIED).
  Tyrese Maxey has lines at every book: he was listed Out at noon (the
  fixture's real injury report), after a 9 AM pull would have bought them.

event_odds_den_sas_constructed.json
  The same request for DEN at SAS. PrizePicks has NOT posted this game: no
  prizepicks entry at all (the case the free PrizePicks-only polls and the
  "No PrizePicks lines yet" notice are for). draftkings has nine points lines
  and two rebounds lines, fanduel five, betmgm two, underdog four.

participants_constructed.json
  GET /v4/sports/basketball_nba/participants: the 30 teams as full names, in
  the shape of the docs' example (full_name and an id that starts "par_"). The
  names are the teams' official full names with "Los Angeles Clippers"; the
  vendor's exact spellings are UNVERIFIED until the probe's step 2 (RF part 4,
  fact 9). The ids are invented.
